title: Google AI Tools & Models Comparison Matrix

models.name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
strengths: Massive 2M token context window
Complex multimodal reasoning over hours of video or audio
High-performance coding and multi-document synthesis
models.bestFor: Large codebase analysis, hour-long video understanding, full-book or enterprise document Q&A

models.name: Gemini 1.5 Flash
strengths: Sub-second time to first token (TTFT)
Ultra-cost-effective high-volume processing
1M token context capacity at fraction of cost
models.bestFor: High-frequency API requests, real-time chatbots, summarization, extraction, data preprocessing

models.name: Gemini 1.0 Ultra

pricing.enterprise: Custom via Google Cloud Vertex AI

strengths: First model to outperform human experts on MMLU benchmark
Deep mathematical and nuanced scientific reasoning
models.bestFor: Complex academic research, theoretical physics/math reasoning, enterprise advisory

models.name: Gemma 2 (27B)
strengths: Outperforms models more than double its size (competitive with 70B models)
Advanced sliding window attention and logit soft-capping
Full local self-hosting privacy
models.bestFor: Private enterprise deployments, on-premise RAG, domain fine-tuning on single A100/H100 or dual GPUs

models.name: Gemma 2 (9B)

pricing.selfHosted: Free (Runs smoothly on consumer RTX 3090/4090 or Apple Silicon Mac M-series)

strengths: Class-leading performance for under 10B parameters
Knowledge-distilled from larger Gemini architectures
Low latency and quantization friendly (4-bit / 8-bit)
models.bestFor: Local developer assistants, consumer-grade hardware serving via Ollama/vLLM, embedded edge apps

models.name: Gemma 2 (2B)

pricing.selfHosted: Free (Runs in CPU RAM, mobile, and browser with WebGPU)

strengths: Ultra-lightweight footprint (~1.5GB quantized)
Runs on mobile phones, IoT, and edge devices with MediaPipe
Very fast generation speed on CPU
models.bestFor: Edge computing, mobile app on-device inference, lightweight text classification & autocomplete

models.name: PaliGemma 2
strengths: SigLIP vision encoder + Gemma 2 decoder architecture
Precise object detection, spatial coordinates, OCR, and visual QA
Fine-tunable for specialized computer vision tasks
models.bestFor: Document understanding, medical imaging analysis, autonomous robotics visual grounding, OCR

models.name: Imagen 3
models.type: Proprietary API / Cloud (Vertex AI & AI Test Kitchen)
strengths: Industry-leading photorealism and fine detail rendering
Flawless typography and text rendering inside generated images
Built-in invisible cryptographic SynthID watermarking
models.bestFor: Marketing visuals, product photography concepts, digital illustration, graphic design typography

models.name: Google Veo
models.contextWindow: Text / Image prompts + Cinematic control flags

pricing.access: Preview via VideoFX & Vertex AI Generative AI Studio

strengths: Consistent temporal physics and visual coherence
Understands cinematic commands: timelapse, aerial pan, dolly zoom, 24fps film look
High prompt fidelity and narrative continuity
models.bestFor: Cinematic storytelling, social media video production, commercial pre-visualization, concept video

models.name: NotebookLM
models.contextWindow: 50 sources per notebook (Up to 500,000 words per source)
models.maxOutput: Full structured briefings, study guides, and multi-speaker Audio Overviews
strengths: Strict citation grounding (zero hallucinations outside provided sources)
Studio-quality, natural two-host conversational podcast generation (Audio Overview)
Seamless Google Drive integration
models.bestFor: Academic literature reviews, corporate report analysis, legal document synthesis, audio study guides
